_comment: Fix demo for #1616 (wide single-rank formations show a facing whipsaw while pivoting onto a new bearing). Before the fix, an AI-controlled 30-wide single-rank Cavalry regiment chasing a detected enemy near the map's hill terrain snapped its facing back and forth between near-opposite headings on nearly every tick instead of settling onto one heading -- PathField._funnel_corner's corner-selection flip-flopped every tick as the regiment approached, and each formed-turn chase decision snapped facing straight to whichever flip-flopping waypoint was current that tick. Watch the regiment take one clean turn onto its target's bearing and hold it, instead of oscillating.
caption: #1616: a 30-wide single-rank Cavalry regiment chasing a detected enemy near the hill takes one clean turn onto its bearing and holds it -- no facing whipsaw.
